subject.title: [Bug]: CLI relay exits silently with code 1 when session lane is blocked — no timeout or busy error surfaced

question: Should same-session `openclaw agent` CLI dispatches return a terminal lane-busy result after the wait threshold, and if so what exit-code/JSON/stderr contract should be permanent?
rationale: The bug is source-backed, but the durable user-visible contract affects orchestration scripts and message delivery expectations, so automation should not choose the final behavior alone.

options.title: Adopt CLI busy result
options.body: Return a structured lane-busy result for CLI-originated calls, render actionable stderr/JSON, and use a maintainer-approved distinct or documented exit code.

options.title: Stderr only, keep code 1
options.body: Surface the busy reason without changing exit-code semantics, reducing compatibility risk at the cost of weaker script discrimination.

options.title: Preserve queued execution
options.body: Keep CLI calls waiting by default and track only diagnostic improvements, leaving the silent-exit bug to a smaller timeout/error-rendering fix.

recommendation.title: Adopt CLI busy result
recommendation.body: Return a structured lane-busy result for CLI-originated calls, render actionable stderr/JSON, and use a maintainer-approved distinct or documented exit code.

likelyOwner.reason: The Gateway-backed CLI relay and adjacent queue diagnostics history make this the strongest available product-contract owner signal.
